The task: a parking app push notification. User is parked at 信義停車場, timer expires in 10 minutes, overtime costs NT$60 per hour.

s1: push title
s2: push body

Rules:
- No chatty phrasing for buttons, titles, status
- No apologizing in error messages, no exclamation marks, no emoji
- No questions as titles
- No explaining how numbers are calculated
- Don't use 約/大概 when number is already an estimate
- No 我們; avoid 你的/您的 unless needed
- Don't repeat what title already says; no explaining the obvious
- No mainland Chinese terms: no 當前、默認、設置、數據、視頻、用戶、緩存、軟件、網絡、信息
- No periods at end of labels/buttons (push notification... probably treat title as label)
- Keep it short

Wait — is this an error state? The notification warns of imminent expiry. It's a warning/routine state. No exclamation marks.

Title ideas: 「停車計時即將到期」— but rule says don't repeat title content in body. Also title shouldn't be a question.

Title: 「計時即將到期」or 「停車計時剩 10 分鐘」. Body: 「信義停車場超時每小時 NT$60」— need to convey parking location and fee.

Actually the notification should include: location 信義停車場, 10 minutes remaining, overtime NT$60/hour.

Option:
s1: "停車計時即將到期"
s2: "信義停車場尚餘 10 分鐘，超時每小時 NT$60"

Check rules: s2 doesn't repeat s1's exact words (s1 says 即將到期, s2 gives specifics). No question, no exclamation, no 約, no 我們/你的. "尚餘" is Taiwan usage. "超時每小時 NT$60" — fine. Maybe "逾時" is more common in Taiwan parking context: 逾時每小時 NT$60. Yes, 逾時 is standard in Taiwan parking lots.

Body: "信義停車場尚餘 10 分鐘，逾時每小時 NT$60"

Length ok. No trailing period... it ends with NT$60, no period. Good. The comma inside is fine.

Alternative title: "計時 10 分鐘後到期" then body: "信義停車場逾時每小時 NT$60". But then title has the number; body gives location and fee. Hmm, either works. But keeping location in body makes sense since user might be at multiple; actually the notification is about one parking. Title could be "信義停車場計時即將到期" and body "尚餘 10 分鐘，逾時每小時 NT$60". That's cleaner: title carries location, body carries details without repeating "到期" info... body says 尚餘10分鐘 which complements 即將到期.

s1: "信義停車場計時即將到期"
s2: "尚餘 10 分鐘，逾時每小時 NT$60"

That's concise. No forbidden words. "逾時" not "超時" — both fine, but 超時 also used. Taiwan parking signs often say "逾時收費". I'll use 逾時.

Numbers: 10 minutes is exact (app knows), NT$60 exact rate. No 約 needed.

Return only JSON.{"s1":"信義停車場計時即將到期","s2":"尚餘 10 分鐘，逾時每小時 NT$60"}

parsed.s1: 信義停車場計時即將到期
parsed.s2: 尚餘 10 分鐘，逾時每小時 NT$60
